nina.l: quick thought-exchange: when a canary fallback happens, do we need per-request causal IDs so downstream services know this request was served under a fallback? wants to keep it short.

 tom.z: yes please. causal_id in headers is small and helps tracing. also helps correlate user reports with fallback windows.

 vikram.s: also include a flag: x-fallback-type: proxy|resume|restart and x-origin-variant. consumers can then decide to relax strictness (e.g., disable exact-match evals during fallback windows).

 nina.l: runtime should inject header on response, router should tag initial request. ensure privacy: don't include model hashes in headers, use opaque short ids.

 safetynet-bot: note created: FALLBACK-TRACING-2026 assigned to nina.l and tom.z. due 2026-04-01.

 nina.l: that's it, short and actionable.
